purpose: Regression check: inspection overlays must display segmentation only.
checks: Latest live reports draw exact saved polygons with no boxes or box selector.
Updated service worker removes the old app-shell cache.
Hide/show toggles segmentation without introducing rectangles.
Export preserves the original detector evidence and report.
Report has no violations in the selected accessibility rules.
Print and mobile views retain aligned polygons without rectangles.
Browser-only legacy fixture never falls back to rectangles.
Browser-only mixed fixture never falls back to rectangles.
Browser-only empty fixture never falls back to rectangles.
Browser-only demo fixture never falls back to rectangles.
